features: Cat: 7 inch High, 3.75 inch Long, 2.5 inch Wide / Ghost: 8.25 x 4.25 x 1.75 inch / Pumpkin: 7.25 x 5 x 1.5 inch
Creatively Cast in Resin to Last Season After Season in a Hand Painted Finish in Black, Orange and White
They Look Great Displayed Together Doing a Happy Halloween Dance or You Can Display them as Separate Pieces Around Your Living Space
Adorable Folk Art Figurines Bring a Festive Spirit to Your Halloween Decor and Are a Fun Way to Decorate Tables and Shelves
description: Halloween is fun, and these dancing Pumpkin Peeps have captured the spirit of the season. A cat, ghost and pumpkin bring a festive energy to your Halloween decor with their happy dancing design. How adorable they will be decorating a table or shelf in your home.These folk art figurines are creatively cast in resin, so they are sure to last year after year. Each piece is hand painted in the colors of the spooky season; black, orange and white. You'll love them displayed together, or you could arrange them around your living space to add that special touch to any room. Measures approximately 7.5 inches high, 4 inches long and 2 inches wide.
